title: Diagnosing Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding in Large Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.16805v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large vision-language models can recognize the objects and attributes in a crowded scene yet assign an attribute to the wrong same-class instance. Generic visual-question-answering accuracy marks the response as wrong, while object-hallucination metrics may regard both the object and attribute as image-supported; neither reveals the transfer. This study formalizes this blind spot as Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding (DSCAM) and presents InstaBind-Lite, a controlled benchmark that makes it directly measurable. Its 524 images contain 529 curated groups of 3-6 same-class entities, 1773 boxed instances, ordered neighbors, distinguishable color-like attributes, and four complementary question levels, yielding 9580 deterministically evaluated questions. translated_title: 诊断大型视觉语言模型中的密集同类属性错绑现象
translated_abstract: 大型视觉语言模型能够识别拥挤场景中的物体和属性，但有时会将某个属性错误地分配给另一个同类的实例。通用的视觉问答准确率会将这种响应标记为错误，而物体幻觉指标可能认为物体和属性都得到图像支持；这两者均无法揭示这种转移。本研究将这一盲区正式定义为“密集同类属性错绑”（DSCAM），并提出了InstaBind-Lite，一个可控基准，使其可直接测量。该基准包含524张图像，内含529组经过整理的3至6个同类实体组，1773个带框实例，有序邻居，可区分的类颜色属性，以及四个互补的问题层级，共生成9580个确定性评估的问题。与现有协议不同，源实例标注将无根据的生成和识别失败与从另一个可见实体复制的属性区分开来。绑定特定的度量指标...
tldr: 本文提出了“密集同类属性错绑”问题，并构建了InstaBind-Lite基准，通过源实例标注精确测量属性错误绑定，弥补了现有评估方法的盲区。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding (DSCAM) and introduces InstaBind-Lite, a controlled benchmark with source-instance annotations to precisely measure attribute misbinding, addressing a blind spot in existing evaluation protocols.
